boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on the Main Street, State Street, and Otterbein Avenue corridors bordering Otterbein’s Westerville orbit.

cards.title: Westerville Public Library
cards.subtitle: State Street corridor — 126 S State St
cards.notes: Use the State Street entrance for books, events, and free Wi-Fi; the library identifies itself as open to all in Uptown.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop with browsing, events, and Wi-Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerville Public Library is at 126 South State Street in Uptown, is open to all, and offers browsing, events, and free Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Library hours listed: Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–9 p.m.; Fri–Sat 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sun 1–6 p.m.

cards.title: Westerville History Museum
cards.subtitle: State Street corridor — inside Westerville Public Library
cards.notes: Enter through the library’s main entrance and browse current exhibits during museum open hours; make an appointment for physical collections.
cards.short_summary: A local-history museum accessed through the public library.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum is in a historic building attached to Westerville Public Library; walk-ins may view current exhibits during open hours.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours listed: Monday–Saturday 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; closed Sunday and Saturday 1–2 p.m.

cards.title: Hanby House
cards.subtitle: West Main Street corridor — 160 W Main St
cards.notes: Arrange a tour or visit during the listed public Saturday season to see the Hanby family home and its preserved music materials.
cards.short_summary: Historic home of composer Benjamin Hanby.
cards.evidence_claim: Hanby House at 160 West Main Street preserves Hanby family furniture, sheet music, and original plates for a first edition of “Darling Nelly Gray.”
cards.access_notes: Scheduled tours and appointments are available; public Saturday hours are listed seasonally. Donations are appreciated.

cards.title: Alum Creek North
cards.subtitle: West Main Street corridor — 221 W Main St
cards.notes: Follow West Main Street to the city park and use its listed trail, playground, and shelter amenities for an outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: A city park at the west end of the Main Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Alum Creek North is a Westerville park at 221 W. Main Street.
cards.access_notes: City parks close at dusk and reopen at dawn; shelter reservations are separate.

cards.title: Benjamin Hanby Park
cards.subtitle: West Main Street corridor — 290 W Main St
cards.notes: Pause along Main Street to view the park’s listed sculpture and brick wall, then use a bench for a short outdoor reset.
cards.short_summary: A compact Main Street park with a sculpture and brick wall.
cards.evidence_claim: Benjamin Hanby Park is at 290 W. Main Street and lists a brick wall, bench, and sculpture among its features.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city-park access; parks close at dusk and reopen at dawn.

cards.title: First Responders Park
cards.subtitle: West Main Street corridor — 374 W Main St
cards.notes: Walk the Main Street corridor to the memorial-entry plaza and take in the lighted flagpole, seating wall, and benches.
cards.short_summary: A memorial-focused park on West Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: First Responders Park at 374 W. Main Street includes a lighted flagpole, memorial/entry plaza, seating wall, and benches.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city-park access; parks close at dusk and reopen at dawn.

cards.title: Otterbein Lake
cards.subtitle: West Main Street corridor — via 221 W Main St
cards.notes: Approach via Alum Creek North and use the listed overlook and pathway for a waterside pause; fishing is a listed feature.
cards.short_summary: A nearby lake with an overlook and pathway.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein Lake is accessed via 221 W. Main Street and lists fishing, an overlook, and a pathway.
cards.access_notes: Access is via Alum Creek North; outdoor city-park hours run dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Kiwanis Picnic Park
cards.subtitle: Otterbein Avenue corridor — 220 Otterbein Ave
cards.notes: Head along Otterbein Avenue to use the recreation pathway and look for the mature wood lot and water tower listed by the city.
cards.short_summary: An Otterbein Avenue park with a pathway and mature trees.
cards.evidence_claim: Kiwanis Picnic Park is at 220 Otterbein Avenue and lists a water tower, recreation pathway, and mature wood lot.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city-park access; parks close at dusk and reopen at dawn.

cards.title: Uptown Rotary Park
cards.subtitle: North State Street corridor — 54 N State St
cards.notes: Use this small State Street plaza as a route landmark and pause at its benches, drinking fountain, and dedication bricks.
cards.short_summary: A brick plaza on North State Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Uptown Rotary Park is at 54 N. State Street and lists benches, a brick plaza, dedication bricks, and a drinking fountain.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city-park access; parks close at dusk and reopen at dawn.

cards.title: Electric Mini Park
cards.subtitle: South State Street corridor — 400 S State St
cards.notes: Continue south on State Street to find the multi-use trail, benches, and Ohio/Erie Trail dedication rock listed at this mini park.
cards.short_summary: A small trail-linked park on South State Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Electric Mini Park is at 400 S. State Street and includes a multi-use trail, benches, and an Ohio/Erie Trail dedication rock.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city-park access; parks close at dusk and reopen at dawn.
